pages.title: Project Atlas - Launch Plan
pages.content:
## Goal
Launch the Atlas customer portal to our pilot customers.

## Launch date
Friday 20 November 2026.

## Owners
- Project owner: Arjun Mehta (Product Manager) owns Project Atlas overall.
- API migration (v1 REST endpoints to the v2 gateway): Rohan Verma.
- Staging environment and deploy pipeline: Priya Nair.

## Pilot customers
3 pilot customers: Halcyon Foods, Brightpath Clinics and Orbit Logistics.

## Risks
The billing endpoints are the largest part of the API migration.

pages.title: Atlas Architecture
pages.content:
Atlas runs on FastAPI with PostgreSQL 16. User sessions are stored in Redis.

All customer traffic goes through the v2 API gateway; the legacy v1 REST endpoints are retired once the API migration is complete.

Rohan Verma maintains the Atlas backend service.

pages.title: Beacon Metric Definitions
pages.content:
Weekly active users (WAU): distinct customer users with at least one session in the last 7 days. Internal Nexora accounts are excluded.

Activation rate: share of new customer accounts that create their first report within 14 days.

pages.title: Q4 Hiring Plan and Salary Bands
pages.content:

pages.title: Project Atlas - Store Rollout Plan
pages.content:
Project Atlas is Vertex Retail's new store rollout. Owner: Vikram Shah.

Go-live: 15 January 2027 for the first 10 stores, and all 40 stores by March 2027.

pages.title: Bug triage summary for login authentication issue
pages.content: During today’s triage we identified that the login failure stems from a null pointer in the token validator when certain user attributes are absent. The issue reproduces consistently on the staging environment and is reflected in the CI pipeline’s failing auth-service test. Rohan will lead the code fix, and Priya will add a dedicated regression test to the pipeline. I will update the product backlog to reflect the priority and communicate the expected resolution timeline to stakeholders. The team agreed to verify the fix on both staging and the integration environment before merging to main.

pages.title: Feature Flag Rollout Planning
pages.content: The team outlined the approach for introducing the new feature flag that controls the experimental UI component. The flag will follow the agreed naming pattern and be stored in the shared config repository. Backend changes will reference the flag through the feature toggle library, and the DevOps pipeline will enforce schema validation during CI. Documentation will be added to the internal wiki, describing the flag purpose, default state, and rollout criteria. A phased rollout will start with internal testers, followed by a broader audience after monitoring. All stakeholders are expected to review the plan before the next sprint.

pages.title: Bug triage process for inventory synchronization
pages.content: The inventory sync component has been generating intermittent lag reports. During the daily triage we reviewed the latest tickets and identified three high‐priority bugs: duplicate SKU entries, delayed stock updates, and a crash when processing large batches. Each bug was assigned to a developer with an initial fix estimate. We added regression tests covering the identified edge cases and updated the runbook to include verification steps for batch sizes over 10k items. The team agreed to monitor the error logs for the next 48 hours and reconvene if any new patterns emerge. This approach keeps the sync reliable while we continue broader improvements.

pages.title: POS Device Configuration Testing Summary
pages.content: During this week we ran the standard configuration validation on the new point‐of‐sale devices installed in Store 12. All devices successfully completed network and peripheral checks. However, two terminals reported tax code mismatches when processing sample transactions. The issue traces back to an outdated tax mapping file that was not refreshed after the recent regional rate update. The team has corrected the file and scheduled a full regression run. Expected completion is tomorrow morning, after which we will close the testing cycle and move the devices to production readiness.
